title: Scale Can’t Overcome Pragmatics: The Impact of Reporting Bias on Vision-Language Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating the frequency of reasoning-related keywords (spatial, temporal, counting, and negation) in large-scale image-text corpora, evaluating Vision-Language Models on reasoning benchmarks to correlate data omission with model performance, and conducting user studies to test whether specific annotation instructions mitigate this bias.
